evidence: Cross-sectional TEM images show that HfO2 layers thinner than 3 nm are amorphous as deposited, while local epitaxial crystallization has occurred in thicker HfO2 films. The HfO2 thickness deduced from TEM is shown in Table II. HfO2 densities were calculated for the three samples by combining the TEM HfO2 thickness and RBS Hf coverage. XRD measurements were performed on as-deposited samples with 100-, 200-, and 300-cycles of HfO2, which correspond to 5-, 9-, and 14-nm, respectively. Figure 10 shows the results for 14-nm HfO2. The as-deposited layer is partially crystalline and is composed of 10 vol % cubic, 10 vol % monoclinic, and 80 vol % amorphous phase.
